evidence.quote: The current stance of monetary policy is well positioned to respond to a range of potential developments.
Price increases tied to changes in trade policy may make it difficult to achieve further progress in the near term. One-year inflation expectations have risen sharply this year.
I will take into account the fact that price stability is essential for achieving long periods of strong labor market conditions.
The labor market has remained resilient, at least through early spring.
One lesson is that the inflation environment can change abruptly, especially in a world with global shocks.

parsed.rationale: The speech acknowledges two-sided risks and signals a patient hold. Its emphasis on rising inflation expectations, the primacy of price stability, and lessons from under-predicted pandemic inflation give it a modest hawkish tilt.
